title: docs: DEVELOPMENT.md's Plugin Bundling layout (:253-258) says daemon/ and proxy/ ship "node_modules minus .bin" and leaves scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs out, though since 864103f3/c76a8bf8 both bundles ship only the lockfiles' production packages (the vsix built from bc4793cf has 30 of the daemon's 65 node_modules entries, no typescript, vitest, tsx or @types) and since 5f731334 the shared manifest ships moe-serena-ignore.mjs
description:
Filed by hunt #20 (task-9f3eac6d), lane 2: both IDE bundles compared with each other and with the docs that describe them.

PROBLEM
- docs/DEVELOPMENT.md:253-254 describe daemon/ and proxy/ as "dist minus *.test.* / *.spec.*, its package.json, node_modules minus .bin". That stopped being true on 11-02, with task-864103f3 (JetBrains) and task-c76a8bf8 (VS Code).
  - Since then each bundle copies only its lockfile's production packages: every packages-map entry not marked `"dev": true`, each without its own nested node_modules.
  - JetBrains: build.gradle.kts `productionPackages` and prepareSandbox's `daemonPackages`/`proxyPackages` loops.
  - VS Code: moe-vscode/scripts/bundle-assets.mjs `productionPackages` (:67-89) and its copy loop (:242-246).
  - So devDependencies never ship.
- docs/DEVELOPMENT.md:255-258 list the bundled scripts without moe-serena-ignore.mjs.
  - scripts/bundle-manifest.json:20 has shipped it in both bundles since 5f731334 (task-c6a24053, 11-03).
  - The wrappers load it: moe-agent.sh `$SCRIPT_DIR/moe-serena-ignore.mjs`, and moe-agent.ps1 names it 4 times.
- The rest of the block matches the manifest and both bundlers, :261 ("mods/ # everything except *.test.ts and .claude-plugin/types/") included.
  - The compiled register.js and register.test.js that still ship belong to task-d27edf88's rework, not to this row.

EVIDENCE (HEAD bc4793cf; lines unchanged at acea850b)
- ci.yml's "Package the VS Code extension and smoke-test its bundle" step, run in a snapshot, built a 1467-file vsix (bundled/), identical to the staged moe-vscode/bundled.
- Listing: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-9f3eac6d/bundles/moe-vscode-vsix-files.txt.
  - `grep -c '^extension/bundled/scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs$'` gives 1.
  - `grep -cE '^extension/bundled/daemon/node_modules/(typescript|vitest|tsx|@types|@vitest)/'` gives 0.
- packages/moe-daemon/node_modules after ci.yml's `npm install` holds 65 entries, including those 5: bundles/installed-daemon-node_modules.txt.
- bundled/daemon/node_modules holds 30: bundles/vsix-daemon-node_modules.txt.
- JetBrains reads the same manifest and applies equivalent rules. The Kotlin and JS lockfile parsers match, and none of the 132 shipped manifest files matches a Gradle default exclude. So the JetBrains zip carries the same set; it was not built (no JDK in WSL).

FIX DIRECTION
- Edit docs/DEVELOPMENT.md only.
  - Lines 253-254: say node_modules holds only the lockfile's production packages (no devDependencies, no .bin), and name where the rule lives, for example "(the lockfile rule in build.gradle.kts and bundle-assets.mjs)".
  - Line 257 or 258: add moe-serena-ignore.mjs.
- Keep the tree format.
- Do not touch scripts/CLAUDE.md: its :41 bundle sentence matches the manifest.

FILES: docs/DEVELOPMENT.md only. Not held by any open row (lanes.js -v at 09:36Z).
PLACEMENT: no dependsOn.
definitionOfDone: `grep -n 'minus .bin' docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` no longer matches the daemon/ or proxy/ layout lines, and those lines say node_modules holds only the lockfile's production packages (no devDependencies).
`grep -n 'moe-serena-ignore.mjs' docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` matches a line inside the "## Plugin Bundling" layout block.
The row's diff touches only docs/DEVELOPMENT.md, and `npm run lint` at the repo root exits 0 in a git-archive snapshot of the fix commit.

implementationPlan.description:
Edit docs/DEVELOPMENT.md's "## Plugin Bundling" layout block with your own Edit tool (DoD 1 and 2). Exactly three lines change; keep the tree format and column alignment.

(a) Lines 253-254 (daemon/ and proxy/): replace `node_modules minus .bin` with `node_modules with only its lockfile's production packages (no devDependencies, no .bin)`. The rest of each line stays as it is: `# moe-daemon dist minus *.test.* / *.spec.*, its package.json, ...` and the proxy twin.

(b) Line 258: `│   ├── moe-account-lease.mjs` becomes `│   ├── moe-account-lease.mjs, moe-serena-ignore.mjs`.

Where the facts come from:
- scripts/bundle-manifest.json:20 ships moe-serena-ignore.mjs.
- Both bundlers copy each lockfile's non-dev packages without their nested node_modules: moe-jetbrains/build.gradle.kts productionPackages (:81-96, copy loops :287-302) and moe-vscode/scripts/bundle-assets.mjs productionPackages (:60-89). So .bin, which is no lockfile package key, and every devDependency (typescript, vitest, tsx, @types) never ship.

Rules:
- Touch nothing else in the file. :261's mods/ line and the paragraph at :267 already match the manifest.
- Do not edit scripts/CLAUDE.md; its bundle sentence (:41) is correct.
- This is a docs-only change: no code, no error handling paths and no runtime behaviour change.
- The only automated reader is packages/moe-daemon/src/util/daemonGitDocs.test.ts, which fails on any line saying the daemon never runs git. The gate greps for that wording too, so do not add it.
- A worked example of the exact edit, validated in a scratch clone, is in step 2's reference run.

This is a docs-only change: no code, test or error handling path changes.
acceptanceCriteria: `grep -n 'minus .bin' docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` prints nothing, and the daemon/ and proxy/ layout lines both say node_modules holds only the lockfile's production packages (no devDependencies).
The '## Plugin Bundling' block names moe-serena-ignore.mjs on the scripts lines.
The diff is exactly docs/DEVELOPMENT.md, and `npm run lint` exits 0 in a snapshot of HEAD with the edited file overlaid.
invariants: Only the three layout lines change (253, 254, 258 at acea850b); the tree format and every other line of the file stay byte-identical.
No line in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md says the daemon never runs git (packages/moe-daemon/src/util/daemonGitDocs.test.ts).
compatibility: scripts/CLAUDE.md:41 and scripts/bundle-manifest.json are unchanged; the doc now agrees with them and with build.gradle.kts / bundle-assets.mjs productionPackages.
checkRefs: ( cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && [ "$(git diff --name-only HEAD)" = docs/DEVELOPMENT.md ] && S=$(mktemp -d) && git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$S" && cp docs/DEVELOPMENT.md "$S/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md" && cd "$S" && B=$(sed -n '/^## Plugin Bundling/,/^## [^P]/p' docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) && ! grep -n 'minus .bin' docs/DEVELOPMENT.md && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$B" | grep -cE '^├── (daemon|proxy)/ .*production packages.*no devDependencies')" = 2 ] && printf '%s\n' "$B" | grep -n 'moe-serena-ignore.mjs' && ! grep -nEi 'never (runs|executes|touches) git|runs no git|does not run git' docs/DEVELOPMENT.md && npm run lint >lint.log 2>&1; E=$?; tail -3 "${S:-.}/lint.log" 2>/dev/null; echo "exit: $E"; exit $E )

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Adding a paragraph that explains the lockfile rule below the tree: not chosen. The DoD wants the layout lines themselves to say it, and the paragraph at :267 already says the daemon/proxy copies stay in each build. (2) Naming the rule's code locations inline in the tree lines: skipped, because the lines are already long. The planning step cites build.gradle.kts and bundle-assets.mjs for the worker and QA instead. (3) Also editing scripts/CLAUDE.md: rejected; its :41 sentence matches the manifest (hunt #20 checked it).
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- The bundle manifest (scripts/bundle-manifest.json) drives the scripts and docs copies in both builds.
- daemon/proxy node_modules use productionPackages in build.gradle.kts:81-96 and bundle-assets.mjs:60-89: non-dev lockfile entries, each copied without its nested node_modules.
- The only test that reads DEVELOPMENT.md is daemonGitDocs.test.ts, a never-runs-git phrasing guard.
planningNotes.risks:
- The tree uses box-drawing characters (├── │). An editor that normalises them, or a stray trailing space, breaks the gate's grep and the rendering. Edit only the text after `#` on 253/254 and append to 258.
- In worktree mode the task worktree holds only this file's diff; the gate's first check fails if anything else is dirty there.
